description: Public spatial assay catalog. Availability refers to the indexed spatial product; clinical donor mappings and raw reads have separate access conditions. Archive-indexed links are distinct from locally byte-verified downloads.

cohorts.title: Spatially resolved transcriptomics reveals genes associated with the vulnerability of middle temporal gyrus in Alzheimer's disease
cohorts.contrast: Alzheimer disease vs control, middle temporal gyrus
cohorts.claim: The authors reported cortical-layer-specific expression differences in middle temporal gyrus and investigated selected markers by in situ hybridization.
cohorts.method: Visium DE used Seurat FindMarkers for AD vs control. Validation compared RNA puncta in annotated cells using Mann–Whitney tests.
cohorts.method_locator: Methods, Differential expression analysis and RNAscope quantification
cohorts.unit_note: Preserve cortical layer and donor ID. Multiple spots within one cortical layer share a donor.

cohorts.title: Ecotypes of triple-negative breast cancer in response to chemotherapy
cohorts.contrast: Pathologic complete response vs residual disease after neoadjuvant chemotherapy for TNBC
cohorts.claim: Pretreatment cell-state communities and cancer-cell programs were associated with response.
cohorts.method: Targetable-gene comparisons across tumour expression archetypes used Wilcoxon rank-sum tests with FDR adjustment (Fig. 2j). Cell-state analyses, pCR vs RD response comparisons (44 spatial donors: 25 pCR / 19 RD), and survival associations used distinct endpoints.
cohorts.method_locator: Fig. 2j (cross-archetype gene comparisons); Results, Tumour archetypes and chemotherapy response; Methods
cohorts.unit_note: Use pretreatment spatial donors. The single-cell and spatial cohorts have different sizes.

cohorts.title: Spatial Multiomics Analyses Reveal That Diabetes Promotes Pancreatic Cancer Progression by Stimulating Cholesterol-Induced Neutrophil Extracellular Trap Formation
cohorts.contrast: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma with vs without pre-existing diabetes
cohorts.claim: Spatial metabolism and transcriptional measurements associated diabetes with cholesterol-related programs in pancreatic tumors.
cohorts.method: The paper describes OPLS-DA, variable-importance and fold-change selection with permutation assessment of the model; Fig. 2 compares tumor-region metabolites. These are distinct analytical endpoints.
cohorts.method_locator: Methods, Metabolomic data analysis; Fig. 2
cohorts.unit_note: Select the imaging assay. Keep ion polarities, tissue regions and clinical cohorts distinct. An assay row is not necessarily a new patient.

cohorts.title: Spatially organized tumor-stroma boundary determines the efficacy of immunotherapy in colorectal cancer patients
cohorts.contrast: Mismatch repair-proficient vs deficient colorectal cancer; response vs stable disease in the prespecified anti-PD-1 subset
cohorts.claim: In this study, spatial organization of the tumor–stroma boundary differed across mismatch-repair and treatment-response groups.
cohorts.method: Leiden clustering identified tissue structures, and Moran’s I evaluated spatial organization. The paper compares specific patient and tissue-region strata.
cohorts.method_locator: Fig. 1 and Supplementary Fig. 2; Methods, Stereo-seq data analysis
cohorts.unit_note: Use the treated dMMR subset for a response comparison; treatment-naive pMMR vs dMMR is a separate contrast. The processed spatial archive includes a second tumor section for CRCP59. Resolve repeated sections before between-patient comparisons. The linked FASTQ collection has separate access conditions.

cohorts.title: Single cell and spatial sequencing define processes by which keratinocytes and fibroblasts amplify inflammatory responses in psoriasis
cohorts.contrast: Psoriatic lesions vs healthy skin
cohorts.claim: The investigators localized keratinocyte inflammatory programs and fibroblasts associated with immune-cell recruitment.
cohorts.method: The spatial analyses included deconvolution, expression maps and module scores. Cluster marker genes within the six Visium datasets were tested with two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum tests and BH correction.
cohorts.method_locator: Main text and Supplementary Data 4 legend (MOESM3, Description of Additional Supplementary Files).
cohorts.unit_note: Visium QC labels identify biopsies. Supplementary Data 1 and 2 do not link each Visium biopsy to an independent donor. Cluster-marker tests address a different estimand from a case-control donor contrast.

cohorts.title: Spatial transcriptomics stratifies psoriatic disease severity by emergent cellular ecosystems
cohorts.contrast: Psoriasis severity and healthy controls; paired lesional and nonlesional skin
cohorts.claim: Spatial cell ecosystems stratified skin by disease severity, including at some nonlesional sites.
cohorts.method: PseudobulkExpression produced sample- and cluster-level counts. DESeq2 collapseReplicates combined technical replicates before differential analysis.
cohorts.method_locator: Methods, Pseudobulk differential gene expression analysis
cohorts.unit_note: Use one predefined independent-donor contrast. Paired lesion status requires a paired design.

cohorts.title: Tracking in situ checkpoint inhibitor-bound target T cells in patients with checkpoint-induced colitis
cohorts.contrast: Active ulcerative colitis vs checkpoint-inhibitor colitis vs healthy controls
cohorts.claim: Checkpoint-inhibitor colitis contained spatial immune microdomains with distinct chemotactic signatures and damaged epithelial regions.
cohorts.method: Generalized linear models related cell-type decomposition scores and pathway AUCs to spatial clusters or disease condition.
cohorts.method_locator: STAR Methods, Visium spatial transcriptomics analysis
cohorts.unit_note: Distinguish activity status and therapy, with sections nested within patients. The study includes several molecular assays.

cohorts.title: Single-cell spatial transcriptomics of formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded biopsies reveals colitis-associated cell networks
cohorts.contrast: Colitis types and healthy controls; vedolizumab response in a selected cohort
cohorts.claim: Distinct inflammatory neighborhoods were associated with vedolizumab nonresponse; an epithelial neighborhood was associated with response.
cohorts.method: Spatial pseudobulk DE used DESeq2. Xenium cell-frequency comparisons used Mann–Whitney or Kruskal–Wallis tests with FDR control according to comparison.
cohorts.method_locator: Methods, Statistics and spatial transcriptomics pseudobulk analysis
cohorts.unit_note: Resolve panel, donor, segmentation and dataset before forming a contrast. Check possible participant overlap with other colitis cohorts.

cohorts.title: Spatial transcriptomics landscape of lesions from non-communicable inflammatory skin diseases
cohorts.contrast: Psoriasis vs atopic dermatitis vs lichen planus; lesional and matched nonlesional biopsies
cohorts.claim: Cytokine transcripts and nearby responder signatures formed localized patterns in inflamed skin.
cohorts.method: Layer-wise spatial enrichment of cytokines was tested with Wilcoxon signed-rank tests; density-based clustering identified nearby responder transcripts.
cohorts.method_locator: Methods, Cytokine quantification and spatial clustering
cohorts.unit_note: Some capture areas contain several donors; duplicates and anatomical matches require the original mapping.

cohorts.title: Spatiotemporal interaction of immune and renal cells controls glomerular crescent formation in autoimmune kidney disease
cohorts.contrast: ANCA-associated GN, lupus nephritis, anti-GBM GN and reference kidney
cohorts.claim: The authors mapped progression from cellular crescents to sclerosis and localized PDGF- and TGFβ-related programs.
cohorts.method: Cell-type marker comparisons used Wilcoxon tests and multiple-testing adjustment. Cell-signaling inference and mechanistic experiments address separate questions.
cohorts.method_locator: Extended Data (cell-type markers); Methods, Cell–cell interactions
cohorts.unit_note: Use the original spatial paper’s data-availability statement. Each slide can contain several biopsies. The additional multimodal slide must be checked for repeat material.

cohorts.title: Spatial analysis reveals cellular microenvironments and mechanisms of inflammation and injury in acute interstitial nephritis
cohorts.contrast: Acute interstitial nephritis vs acute tubular injury vs reference kidney
cohorts.claim: The investigators described inflammatory neighborhoods around injured proximal tubules with complement and NAMPT signals.
cohorts.method: Proximal-tubule DE in AIN vs ATI used Wilcoxon with Bonferroni adjustment. Reference ST tissue values were presented descriptively for the specified cortex analysis.
cohorts.method_locator: Proximal tubule results; Methods, Statistical analysis of cell densities and spatial neighbors
cohorts.unit_note: Use the per-cell biopsy assignment and distinguish cortex from medulla. Reference tissue is a small descriptive group.

cohorts.title: Single-cell spatial transcriptomic profiling defines a pathogenic inflammatory niche in chronic active multiple sclerosis lesions
cohorts.contrast: Chronic active multiple sclerosis lesions vs healthy white matter; paired domains within lesions
cohorts.claim: CD8 T cells near inflamed foamy microglia were localized to chronic active lesion rims.
cohorts.method: BANKSY defined spatial domains and SPATA2 modelled spatial gradients. NMF characterized T-cell neighborhoods; marker analyses used Seurat FindAllMarkers.
cohorts.method_locator: Fig. 1 and Fig. 2; STAR Methods, Spatial gradient analysis
cohorts.unit_note: The original MERFISH results explicitly include healthy control tissues. Match to supplementary donor identifiers: run-region names alone do not establish patient identity.

cohorts.title: Spatial transcriptomics identifies molecular niche dysregulation associated with distal lung remodeling in pulmonary fibrosis
cohorts.contrast: Fibrotic lung vs unaffected donors; multiple regions per donor
cohorts.claim: Airspace remodeling was associated with a progression of epithelial and macrophage changes.
cohorts.method: Logit-transformed proportions were regressed on pathology; limma-voom models of pathology-aggregated counts included TMA origin.
cohorts.method_locator: Methods, Differential expression across pathologies and pseudotime
cohorts.unit_note: Retain donor, pathology, TMA and anatomical region identifiers. Subsamples of one lung share a donor.

cohorts.title: Distinct tissue niches direct lung immunopathology via CCL18 and CCL21 in severe COVID-19
cohorts.contrast: Acute, chronic and prolonged COVID-19 vs non-COVID pneumonia controls
cohorts.claim: The authors identified CCL18- and CCL21-associated tissue niches in prolonged lung pathology.
cohorts.method: Gene-set enrichment used fgsea on Wilcoxon-ranked genes. Figures comparing disease stages report the tests used in each panel.
cohorts.method_locator: Methods, Gene set enrichment analysis; Fig. 1
cohorts.unit_note: The control diagnosis is pneumonia. Interpret disease-duration categories with the timing of autopsy sampling.

cohorts.title: Induced B cell receptor diversity predicts PD-1 blockade immunotherapy response
cohorts.contrast: Basal cell carcinoma before vs after PD-1 blockade; response and tissue-site strata
cohorts.claim: The paper observed spatial co-clustering of T- and B-cell pseudoclones and associations with treatment exposure.
cohorts.method: Neighborhood enrichment assessed spatial co-occurrence. The authors correlated paired pseudoclone sizes across spatial and treatment strata.
cohorts.method_locator: Results, Spatial transcriptomics of the BCR and TCR repertoires; Fig. 4
cohorts.unit_note: A longitudinal biopsy, lymph node and skin section can belong to one donor. A pre/post analysis requires matched inference.

cohorts.title: Mapping spatially resolved transcriptomes in human and mouse pulmonary fibrosis
cohorts.contrast: Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis vs unaffected human lung
cohorts.claim: Aberrant alveolar epithelial cells localized within fibrotic niches enriched in TGFβ-related signals.
cohorts.method: The investigators pooled counts by donor for pseudobulk DE. DESeq2 also contrasted control alveolar regions with IPF alveolar or fibrotic regions.
cohorts.method_locator: Fig. 1; Methods, Differential expression analysis; Data availability
cohorts.unit_note: This accession is the public processed human subset. The associated mouse GEO study uses a different accession.

cohorts.title: Spatial single-cell profiling reveals macrophage niches in severe COVID-19 lungs
cohorts.contrast: Severe COVID-19 vs non-pulmonary control autopsies
cohorts.claim: The authors described different macrophage-centered niches in fibrotic and alveolar tissue.
cohorts.method: BuildNicheAssay clustered local cell-type neighborhoods across both slides. FindMarkers DE for gene ontology used Bonferroni-adjusted p values.
cohorts.method_locator: Methods §§2.6–2.8
cohorts.unit_note: GEO states that cases and controls occupy separate slides. Preserve slide labels and specimen identity.

cohorts.title: An aberrant immune-epithelial progenitor niche drives viral lung sequelae
cohorts.contrast: Post-acute COVID lung fibrosis vs controls, human spatial subset
cohorts.claim: Human fibrotic regions showed spatial association between CD8 T-cell signatures and dysplastic epithelial repair.
cohorts.method: The human spatial figures compare mapped cell-type gene signatures and enriched regions. Wilcoxon rank-sum tests are reported for expression comparisons in the broader study.
cohorts.method_locator: Extended Data, human lung ST maps and mouse validation; Methods, Spatial transcriptomics
cohorts.unit_note: Only human Visium belongs in this contrast; the experimental perturbations were performed in animals.

cohorts.title: Spatial multi-omic map of human myocardial infarction
cohorts.contrast: Myocardial infarction vs control donor hearts; distinct regions of an infarcted heart
cohorts.claim: Spatial neighborhoods distinguished injury, repair and remodeling after ischemic damage.
cohorts.method: One-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum tests compared estimated cell-type composition of a niche against other niches, with adjusted p values.
cohorts.method_locator: Fig. 2 and Methods, Spatial transcriptomic profiling
cohorts.unit_note: Select Visium H5AD assets and carry heart identity through infarct, border and remote regions.

cohorts.title: Spatial transcriptomic characterization of pathologic niches in IPF
cohorts.contrast: Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis vs control, processed Visium subset
cohorts.claim: The investigators described fibrotic, macrophage and immune niches in lung tissue.
cohorts.method: The study estimated cell-type abundance with cell2location, compared abundances using Pearson correlations and used Squidpy neighborhood enrichment.
cohorts.method_locator: Fig. 2 and Methods, Spatial neighborhood enrichment
cohorts.unit_note: Combine technical sections only within donor. Visium and validation Xenium cover different sampling units.

cohorts.title: Single-cell Stereo-seq reveals induced progenitor cells involved in axolotl brain regeneration
cohorts.contrast: Axolotl post-injury time points and uninjured tissue
cohorts.claim: The authors described injury-induced progenitor states at the wound site and a possible regenerative lineage.
cohorts.method: RNA velocity and Monocle pseudotime were used to infer cell-state trajectories. These analyses estimate direction and ordering.
cohorts.method_locator: Results, ReaEGCs and intermediate progenitors; Fig. 4
cohorts.unit_note: Animal benchmark. Multiple rostrocaudal sections can come from one brain. Map each section to an animal before between-animal inference.

cohorts.title: Spatial profiling of lung adenocarcinoma and normal lung specimens
cohorts.contrast: Lung adenocarcinoma vs normal lung specimens
cohorts.claim: The archive provides expression, FOV and segmentation data for characterizing spatial heterogeneity; the series summary does not specify a tested spatial association.
cohorts.method: No linked publication or named inferential test could be substantiated from this record. Series design describes imaging and segmentation.
cohorts.method_locator: GEO Series summary and overall design
cohorts.unit_note: The archive establishes specimen counts. Independent donor identities and pairing require additional documentation.

cohorts.title: Spatial transcriptomics reveals compartment-specific cytotoxic T cell crosstalk with AT2 and goblet cells in advanced COPD
cohorts.contrast: Advanced COPD vs healthy donor lung
cohorts.claim: The study localized cytotoxic T-cell interactions with alveolar type 2 and goblet cells in different lung compartments.
cohorts.method: Visium COPD vs donor-control differential expression used donor-aggregated pseudobulk DESeq2 negative-binomial Wald tests with BH adjustment (Fig. 3; Methods). Separate ligand and receptor expression comparisons across cell populations used Wilcoxon tests with FDR correction on combined scRNA-seq cohorts (GSE171541, GSE136831).
cohorts.method_locator: Methods and Fig. 3 (Visium donor-level DESeq2); scRNA-seq crosstalk panels (GSE171541, GSE136831)
cohorts.unit_note: GEO identifies each donor and acquisition batch. Disease status also captures the difference between donor tissue sources.

cohorts.title: Spatial and Single-Cell Mapping Reveals Valvular Interstitial Cell and Macrophage Sex Differences in Calcific Aortic Valve Disease
cohorts.contrast: Female vs male diseased human aortic valves in the Visium assay
cohorts.claim: The investigators reported localized COMP expression near calcification in male valves and increased SERPINE1 in fibrotic female valve tissue.
cohorts.method: The spatial analysis used Moran’s I for spatial clustering and Wilcoxon rank-sum tests for sex-associated expression.
cohorts.method_locator: Methods, spatial transcriptomics cell scoring and spatial distribution; Fig. 5
cohorts.unit_note: Match by numbered patient, preserve A/B repeat sections, include only spatial GSMs with deposited tissue positions and restrict to diseased valves.

access_exclusions.reason: CNSA marks access as Controlled and lists a data application portal. The project is excluded from the openly downloadable human cohort count.
